name: WLF_LEARN_EVENT
description: Table to store learn event information.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the event, like LearningRecordCompletion.

columns.name: EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Datetime when the event was raised.

columns.name: EVENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The person identifier who raised the event.

columns.name: EVENT_PERSONA
columns.description: The persona who raised the event: (Learner, Manager, Specialist).

columns.name: EVENT_SYSTEM_TYPE
columns.description: Even raised thru UI or through a background job.

columns.name: EVENT_SOURCE
columns.description: EVENT_SOURCE

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: SUBJECT_ID

columns.name: SUBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: SUBJECT_TYPE

columns.name: EVENT_STATUS
columns.description: EVENT_STATUS

columns.name: EVENT_PHASE
columns.description: EVENT_PHASE

columns.name: EVENT_CONSUMERS_COUNT
columns.description: EVENT_CONSUMERS_COUNT

columns.name: EVENT_CONSUMERS
columns.description: EVENT_CONSUMERS

columns.name: EVENT_PROCESSED_DATE
columns.description: EVENT_PROCESSED_DATE

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OTHER_INFO
columns.description: OTHER_INFO

columns.name: EVENT_OWNER
columns.description: Represents owner of the event.
